description: Returns a kipode.de page as clean Markdown (text, tables, sources, without menu). Required: url or path, e.g. "https://kipode.de/rente-deutschland.html" or "/insolvenzen/". Long pages are cut after max_chars (default 60000).

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return before cutting (default 60000).

url.description: Full kipode.de URL or path, e.g. "https://kipode.de/rente-deutschland.html" or "/insolvenzen/".

name: seite_als_markdown
title: Page as Markdown
